div.head: ECf 32 A 11
div.ab: Quodsi qui eorum heredes uel parentes non habuerint, dominus suus illa recipiet; et si dominum non haberet, felagus suus, id est fide cum eo ligatus, si haberet, illa recipiet. Si uero nichil istorum haberet, tunc [rex] regni, sub cuius protectione et pace degunt uniuersi, illa resumet.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 656 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints across the page as an insertion into ECf retr. 32 (32 A–E, pp. 655–660). The dictionary cites it as “ECf 32 A …”, so it is kept with ECf here.

Liebermann prints some words here in smaller type (heredes, parentes non habuerint, dominus, recipiet, dominum non haberet, felagus, fide cum eo ligatus, si haberet, Si uero nichil istorum … resumet); they are taken over from ECf. retr. 15, 7, which his margin names.

note.seg: der Vormund, regelmässig der Herr, verwaltet die Waffen des Unmündigen nach der Assisa armorum. Der Londoner setzt aber aus ECf. die Instanzen ein, welche den Verwandten-Antheil am Murdrum empfangen
the guardian, regularly the lord, administers the arms of a minor according to the Assisa armorum. But the Londoner puts in, from ECf., the parties who receive the kinsmen’s share of the murdrum
ergänzt aus ECf. 15, 7; fehlt Hss. Ld
supplied from ECf. 15, 7; lacking in the MSS, Ld

div.ab: But if any of them have no heirs or kinsmen, his lord shall receive them; and if he had no lord, his felagus (fellow), that is, one bound to him by faith, if he had one, shall receive them. But if he had none of these, then the [king] of the kingdom, under whose protection and peace all men live, shall take them back.

note.seg: Verf. verwendet fälschend dieselben Bestimmungen aufs Vererben der Waffen, die ECf auf die Verwendung des Sippenteiles der Murdrumbusse gemünzt hatte: also wertlos; s. u. A 15. — fel. eius solus fide [wie 15,7] Rs — rex6 richtig Rs

The author falsely applies to the inheritance of arms the same provisions that ECf had framed for the use of the kindred's share of the murdrum fine: therefore worthless; see below, A 15. — fel. eius solus fide [as 15,7] Rs — rex6 correctly Rs
